auditFix.issue: 굴다 takes the [adverb]-게 굴다 pattern (e.g., 무례하게 굴다, 버릇없이 굴다); 굴게 inverts this since 굴다 is not used adverbially. Additionally, 굴다 and 행동하다 are near-synonyms ('to act/behave'), so stacking them is redundant.

auditFix.issue: Confirmed broken: 탐내다가 parses as the connective -다가 ('while coveting...'), giving 'while coveting, it echoed across the field' — nonsensical. The fix cites the move name with the 라는 naming particle and uses 기술이 as the actual subject of 울려 퍼지다.
